text:
maria_chen: quick update — I ran a micro-benchmark comparing p50/p95 for the new quantized Llama2-xl variant across h100 vs a100 across three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with the new edge mux routing turned on. attached charts show p50 wins on h100 in us-west but p95 jumps in eu-west for a100.
li_k: can you drop the exact command you used to collect metrics?
maria_chen: sure — used the bench harness on canary pool: 
```
./bench_runner --model llama2-xl-int8 --kernels triton,fused_attn --gpus h100,a100 --regions us-east,us-west,eu-west --metric p50,p95 --warmup 200 --duration 600
```
maria_chen: also fed the same prompt-set and pinned kv-cache priming to 50 tokens to control warmup variance. charts: small p50 improvement (~8-10ms) on h100-us-west, throughput roughly same; p95 on a100-eu-west increased by ~45ms and has heavier tail.
davidp: interesting. did routing cause extra hop count for eu-west? any proxy egress changes?
maria_chen: yes — when mux route picks fallback to regional-capacity it sometimes proxies through the central egress for eu-west under load. hop count +1 correlates with those p95 spikes. i toggled routing policy to prefer local-capacity and p95 drop was visible in smoke run.
natalie: could this be kernel selection? a100 might be switching to fallback kernel (generic matmul) under long sequences and that adds tail. can we log kernel decisions per request?
maria_chen: we have a small runtime flag: kernel_debug=1. ran a 1k-sample trace and saw ~30% of a100 eu-west p95 requests used fallback kernel when seq_len > 512.
li_k: action items: 1) add kernel decision tagging to traces for canary 2) disable cross-pop proxy fallback for eu-west for next 2-hour canary 3) run capacity sizing sim with burst load to capture tail.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-policy update to prefer-local for eu-west on canary cluster in 10m.
davidp: for long-term, we should test quantization profiles + kernel combos: int8 static vs per-channel, and measure p95 at 99th percentile user traffic patterns. also check warmup cache hit rates — prefix caching could mask real cost.
maria_chen: noted. i'll run a targeted sweep: kernels [triton,fused_attn,custom_cuda], quant profiles [int8-pq,int8-pc], regions same, and report p50/p95 + throughput charts. short-term: revert mux fallback for eu-west on canary and watch p95 for next 2 hours.
li_k: thanks — drop results in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
